label: Anakin Io
description: Scrape, search, crawl, run Wire actions and monitor websites

operations.name: scrape_url
operations.description: Submit a URL to scrape. Returns a job ID — poll GET /url-scraper/{jobId} (with a delay in between) to fetch the completed markdown/JSON.

operations.name: scrape_url_sync
operations.description: Scrapes a single URL and returns the result in the same response, so no polling is needed. Takes the same body as POST /url-scraper. If the scrape takes longer than about 90 seconds, the response is a 202 with an `id` and a non-terminal `status`; fetch the result later with GET /url-scraper/{jobId}. A failed scrape also returns 200 with `status: "failed"`, so check `status`. Limited to 20 requests per minute.

operations.name: get_scrape_result
operations.description: Fetch the status and results of a scrape job started by Extract Website Data.

operations.name: search
operations.description: AI-powered web search with citations. Synchronous — returns immediately, no polling needed. Costs 3 credits per call.

operations.name: start_research
operations.description: Start a multi-stage AI research pipeline: search, scrape citations, extract structured data. Returns a job ID — poll GET /agentic-search/{jobId} (with a delay in between, this can take minutes) to fetch the report. Costs 10 credits.

operations.name: get_research_result
operations.description: Fetch the status and results of an agentic search job started by Start Agentic Search.

operations.name: map_site
operations.description: Discover all reachable URLs under a given site — internal links, external links, and counts. Submit a URL to map. Returns a job ID — poll GET /map/{jobId} (with a delay in between) to fetch the completed link list.

operations.name: get_map_result
operations.description: Fetch the status and results of a map job started by Map a Site's URLs.

operations.name: crawl_site
operations.description: Bulk-fetch markdown across a site — catalog ingestion, site-wide RAG corpora. Submit a URL to crawl. Returns a job ID — poll GET /crawl/{jobId} (with a delay in between) to fetch the completed pages.

operations.name: get_crawl_result
operations.description: Fetch the status and results of a crawl job started by Crawl a Site.

operations.name: discover_wire_actions
operations.description: Find Wire actions for a task from a natural-language intent. Wire is a catalog of pre-built automation actions across hundreds of websites (Amazon, Walmart, LinkedIn, Airbnb, Zillow, and others) — read actions extract data, write actions perform interactions. Many read actions need no authentication. Returns ranked candidate actions, each with its action_id, type (read/write), required/optional params, credit cost, and whether auth is needed. Run a returned action with Run a Wire Action.

operations.name: list_wire_catalogs
operations.description: List every website supported by Wire and its action count.

operations.name: get_wire_catalog
operations.description: Get one catalog's full action list with exact parameter schemas, each action's type (read/write), auth mode (none/optional/required), and credit cost — plus the login fields for credentials-mode sites.

operations.name: run_wire_action
operations.description: Run a Wire action by its action_id — either a READ action that extracts data (search listings, fetch a product's price/specs/reviews, read a profile) or a WRITE action that performs a state-changing interaction (submit a form, add to cart). The action's type, reported by Discover Wire Actions and Get a Wire Catalog, determines which kind it is. params must match that action's parameter schema; omit for actions that take none. Some actions complete synchronously and return their data inline in this same response; others return {status, job_id} — poll GET /wire/jobs/{jobId} for those. Does not execute payments or transfer funds; such actions are refused.

operations.name: get_wire_job
operations.description: Fetch the status and result of an asynchronous Wire action job started by Run a Wire Action.

operations.name: list_wire_identities
operations.description: List your saved Wire identities and their credentials. An identity is a named account on a site; each credential's id is the credential_id passed to Run a Wire Action for actions whose auth_mode is "required". Optionally filter by catalog_id.

operations.name: build_wire_action
operations.description: Request a brand-new Wire action for a website that isn't in the catalog yet. Describe the site (website_url) and what the action should do or extract (goal); Wire generates and auto-tests a scraper, then publishes it. Asynchronous (returns status "pending") and charges credits, refunded automatically if the build fails.

operations.name: create_monitor
operations.description: Create a scheduled website monitor that checks a URL every intervalMinutes (min 15) and records a change when the content differs — optionally alerting a webhook or email. scope "page" (default) watches one URL; "site" crawls the site each run and tracks pages added/removed/changed; "wire" runs a Wire action each check and diffs its JSON. watchMode "full_page" (2 credits/check) compares the whole page; "specific_data" (3 credits/check) extracts only the fields in outputSchema with AI — ideal for price/stock/status tracking. aiMode (+1 credit/check) filters out trivial noise and summarizes real changes. Active-monitor caps per plan: Free 5, Pro 20, Scale 100.

operations.name: list_monitors
operations.description: List your website monitors.

operations.name: get_monitor
operations.description: Fetch one monitor's full configuration and status (next/last check time, active state, per-check credit cost, alert settings).

operations.name: delete_monitor
operations.description: Permanently remove a monitor and its change history. Irreversible.

operations.name: get_monitor_changes
operations.description: Get the detected changes for a monitor — each entry records when the watched content differed from the previous check, with a diff/summary (and the AI change summary when aiMode is on).

operations.name: pause_monitor
operations.description: Stop scheduled checks for a monitor.

operations.name: resume_monitor
operations.description: Restart scheduled checks for a paused monitor. May hit the plan's active-monitor cap.

operations.name: run_monitor
operations.description: Trigger an immediate out-of-schedule check. Billed like a normal check.
